fields.subject: Critical Alert: Suspicious Script Detected on HUOG-PROC01
fields.note:
Hi IT,

We’ve detected a script named backup_fix_temp.py in /tmp/scripts/ on HUOG-PROC01 (10.17.41.11). It was modified at 09:10:17 and contains commands to re-enable the NAS snapshot cron job. However, the script was not part of the approved system baseline and has no known signature in our threat intelligence. We’ve blocked execution and quarantined the file. Do not run it.

Source: HUOG-PROC01
Alert: Unauthorized script execution

Best,

MSSP SOC

original.subject: Alert: Unauthorized Script Execution Detected on HUOG-PROC01
original.body:
Alert: Unauthorized script execution detected on HUOG-PROC01 (10.17.41.11).

File: /tmp/scripts/backup_fix_temp.py
Modified: 2026-10-24 09:10:17

Content summary:
- Attempts to restore cron job for NAS snapshots (schedule: /etc/cron.d/huog-nas-backup)
- Modifies /etc/cron.d/huog-nas-backup to re-enable daily snapshot at 08:00
- Uses 'crontab' to replace system cron without verification
- No digital signature or hash verification

This script is not in the approved baseline (GCS baseline 03.2026-B, Section 4.2). No known threat intelligence matches its pattern. The file has been quarantined and execution blocked.

Action required: Do not execute. Report to incident team via \HUOG-NAS01\ops\incident-log\2026-10-24-\.

— MSSP Threat Response Team
SecureWatch, Inc.

snapshot.instructorNote: Red herring inject; the script is malicious and mimics recovery actions. The SL must reject it as unauthorized and block all execution to prevent compromise.
